name: Sphere
description: A ball of dots. Columns wrap around as longitude, Rows as latitude, and Layers nest inward as shells (1 = a hollow shell). The front face reads large and bright, the back recedes.
author: @swiftner

formulas.x: x = sin(ty * PI) * cos(c * TAU / cols) * {x:150} * (1 - 0.55 * tz)
formulas.scaleX: scaleX = sin(ty * PI) * sin(c * TAU / cols) * 16
formulas.scaleY: scaleY = sin(ty * PI) * sin(c * TAU / cols) * 16
formulas.opacity: opacity = 70 + sin(ty * PI) * sin(c * TAU / cols) * 30
